items.t: Water leaks through the roof seals
items.job: Adjust roof and replace header/door seals or drain tubes
items.note: Owners report about $227-$800 depending on which seals are replaced.

items.t: Convertible top stops working or won't open fully
items.job: Repair roof tension strings, clips, cable guides or sensors
items.note: Small parts often fix it; CarComplaints lists a typical cost of about $2,700 when larger roof parts are needed.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner fails and damages the engine
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides (before failure)
items.note: After a failure, owners report $3,100-$8,000 for engine repair or replacement.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption and engine damage
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $3,700 typical; start with a PCV check and oil consumption test.

items.t: ABS module failure with ABS and stability lights
items.job: Replace ABS control module and bleed brakes

items.t: ABS control unit can fail during braking (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: DSG transmission can shift into neutral (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: Ignition coil failure and misfires
PCV valve or oil separator failure and rough idle
items.note: An owner paid about $350 including spark plugs.

items.t: Water pump or thermostat housing coolant leak
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing

items.t: Carbon buildup on intake valves
High-pressure fuel pump failure with hesitation
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump (and cam follower on FSI)

items.t: Power window regulator fails or window won't close
Turbo diverter valve failure and boost loss
Timing belt and tensioner wear on the 2.0T FSI
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and water pump
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,484-$1,956 for a timing belt replacement.

items.t: Vacuum pump oil leak
items.note: An owner was quoted about $560 for the job.

items.t: Thermostat stuck open and engine runs cool
Intake manifold flap motor failure
items.job: Replace intake flap motor or intake manifold

items.t: Clutch failure or can't shift into gear (manual)
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $1,759-$2,614. Transmission damage costs more.

items.t: Xenon headlight ballast failure
items.note: Owners report about $480-$850 including bumper removal.

items.t: Trunk latch problem stops the roof from working
Keyless entry and push-button start not recognizing the key
items.job: Diagnose and replace Kessy module or antennas
items.note: Often covered under warranty when new.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: Airbag clock spring can lose connection (recall)
items.note: Free at a Volkswagen dealer under the recall.

items.t: Clock spring breaks: airbag light on and horn dead
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $600 typical. Check for the earlier recall first.
